items.excerpt: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers - the built-in TSV and CSV export mechanisms now use this as well, and plugins can register themselves as capable of streaming every row in a table in one go via the new Response.stream() method. items.title: datasette-apps 0.4a0
items.excerpt: Release: datasette-apps 0.4a0 Datasette Apps are sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that live inside Datasette - think Claude Artifacts, but these ones can run SQL queries against your data. 0.4a0 adds support for linking: you can link to an app with #fragments in the URL and the app can see and use those, plus supported URL schemes are reported back to Datasette Agent so it can help write apps that link to each other. items.title: datasette-agent 0.6a0
items.excerpt: Release: datasette-agent 0.6a0 Accumulated small fixes for Datasette Agent, my agent plugin for Datasette that lets you ask questions about your data.
